english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone feels socially uncomfortable or awkward because they are aware of themselves.
Use this for feeling uneasy or ill at ease in a social situation or around particular people.
Use this when “insecure” mainly means uncomfortable or ill at ease in a particular social situation rather than lacking confidence generally.
Choose this when someone's manner or a situation feels awkward, constrained, or socially uncomfortable.

examples.english: I felt self-conscious when I hosted a show for the first time.
examples.traditional: 我第一次上台做主持，成個人都覺得唔自在。
